name: @activepieces/piece-proxycurl
description: Enrich LinkedIn people and company profiles with Proxycurl.

auth.description:
To use Proxycurl:
1. Sign in to your Proxycurl account at https://nubela.co/proxycurl.
2. Open your dashboard and copy your API key.
3. Paste the API key here.

Authentication note:
- Proxycurl's public SDK/docs show Bearer token authorization for API requests.

get_person_profile.name: get_person_profile
get_person_profile.description: Fetch a LinkedIn person profile from Proxycurl.

linkedin_profile_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates

aiMetadata.description: Enrich a single individual by fetching their LinkedIn person profile from Proxycurl. Choose this when you already have a person's public LinkedIn profile URL and need their structured profile data; for finding people without a known URL use Search People instead. Requires the public LinkedIn profile URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates). Read-only lookup, safe to repeat.

get_company_profile.name: get_company_profile
get_company_profile.description: Fetch a LinkedIn company profile from Proxycurl.

url.description: LinkedIn company URL, for example https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/

aiMetadata.description: Enrich a company by fetching its LinkedIn company profile from Proxycurl. Choose this when you have a company's LinkedIn URL and need its structured firmographic data. Requires the LinkedIn company URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/). Read-only lookup, safe to repeat.

search_people.name: search_people
search_people.description: Search for people in Proxycurl using lightweight keyword filters.

country.description: Optional country filter, for example us, gb, or sg.

headline.description: Optional keywords expected in the person headline.

summary_keywords.description: Optional keywords expected in the summary/about section.

aiMetadata.description: Find people via Proxycurl using keyword filters (country, headline keywords, summary keywords) when you do not already have a specific LinkedIn profile URL; to enrich a known URL use Get Person Profile instead. At least one filter must be provided or the call fails. Read-only search, safe to repeat.

lookup_person_email.name: lookup_person_email
lookup_person_email.description: Lookup the work email address for a LinkedIn person profile.

linkedin_profile_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL to enrich.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for async completion callbacks from Proxycurl.

aiMetadata.description: Resolve the work email address for a person from their LinkedIn profile URL via Proxycurl. Choose this when you have a profile URL and specifically need a contact email rather than the full profile. Requires the public LinkedIn profile URL; an optional callback URL receives an async completion webhook. Read-only lookup, safe to repeat.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to any Proxycurl endpoint.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
